description: This file defines a 'ProductDetail' component for a furniture shopping app's frontend, displaying product information, handling layout resizing, and user interactions like adding a product to the cart.

classes.name: ProductDetail
classes.description: A Lightning JS component that displays detailed information about a product, including image, title, price, description, and add-to-cart functionality.

methods.name: onInit
methods.description: Initializes component, loads products if necessary, and sets the selected product based on the provided 'id' prop.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds the current product to the shopping cart via AppStore.
